title: Anchored mini-tutorials for rollout and cost journeys
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Problem: First-time users land on the Console dashboards and rollouts with dense controls (canary %, model variants, autoscale) and cost cards that summarize token spend. They hesitate to change defaults because they lack contextual guidance. Goal: Ship a set of small, anchored mini-tutorials (1-3 steps each) that attach to specific UI elements (cost cards, rollout toggles, traffic slider) and teach action + impact (what happens, why it matters for cost and reliability). These should be consumable in 10–30 seconds, dismissible, and re-openable from a Help menu. Solution approach: create a library of anchored micro-guides with lightweight copy, simple two-state illustrations, and a telemetry hook to track completion and drop-off. Prioritize: 1) cost card explainer for token unit and common levers (batching, quantization), 2) rollout traffic slider walkthrough (canary -> gradual rollout), 3) per-route cost breakdown tooltip. Deliverables: Figma prototype, interactive React microcomponent spec, copy deck, acceptance criteria, and test plan.
acceptance_criteria: Anchored mini-tutorials appear next to target controls on first visit or when explicitly triggered
Each mini-tutorial is 1–3 steps and includes an action + expected result + cost impact line
Controls remain fully operable while tutorial is open; tutorial can be dismissed and reopened from Help
Telemetry events emitted for shown, step, completed, dismissed to Console analytics
Prototype validated with 5 internal usability sessions with clear next-step intent >80%
tasks: Create Figma frames for cost-card micro-tutorial (Evelyn)
Prototype anchored positioning rules and overflow behavior (Design)
Draft concise copy and micro-illustrations (Evelyn + Content)
Align on accessibility: focus management and keyboard dismiss (Marco)
Engineering feasibility sync: constraints for rendering anchors in iframe/embedded routes (Eng)
Instrument telemetry events in spec and add to analytics board (Eng + PM)
Run 5 internal usability tests and capture qualitative notes (Design Ops)
Polish and ship MVP to Canary cohort (Release)
Measure activation and cost-aware changes over 2 weeks; iterate
comments: 2025-02-12 — Evelyn Chen: Initial ticket created. Framing the problem from onboarding funnels — new users who hit 'Deploy' or 'Rollout' often bounce or leave defaults unchanged. Proposed micro-guides should be non-modal and actionable. See attached Figma starter frames.

2025-02-14 — Marco Ruiz: Reviewed prototype. Major engineering consideration: anchors must survive layout shifts and the Console sometimes renders routes inside cross-origin iframes for private deployments. Suggest fallback to inline help drawer if anchor can't be attached. Also flagged accessibility (aria-describedby + focus trap avoidance).

2025-02-15 — Priya Menon (PM): Love the short form. Requested an explicit step that calls out cost delta (example: 'Turning on batching reduced estimated cost by ~30% for this route') — we need a backend estimate API to power accurate numbers. Added as dependency: ENG-19840.

2025-02-16 — Design critique summary: Keep copy <20 words per step, add micro-illustrations for 'before/after' where helpful. Prefer anchored popover with a subtle pulse on first show. Recommendation: show only 1 mini-tutorial per session to avoid overwhelm.

2025-02-17 — Research: Ran 6 internal sessions. Key finding: participants who saw the cost-card mini-guide adjusted sampling/batching 4/6 times. Time-on-task average 18s. Feedback: 'Show me a real example of cost delta' and 'allow me to see more details if I want them'.

2025-02-18 — Engineering lead (Noah James): Confirmed telemetry contract. Implementation notes: we will expose a micro-guides registry and an anchor API. If anchor fails, fall back to Help menu entry. Also called out that rollout slider is in a shared component—changes must be backward compatible.

2025-02-19 — Evelyn Chen: Updated Figma to add the Help menu entry and a compact history of dismissed guides. Added copy variants for localization testing. Next: finalize spec for dev handoff and write acceptance test checklist.

2025-02-20 — Marco Ruiz: Drafted dev tasks and estimate (3 points). Blocking: ENG-19840 (cost-estimate API) and design QA for RTL and keyboard navigation. Setting status to In Progress and assigning to implementation sprint 2025-W08.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive anchoring gives immediate context but introduces fragility across deployments. Fallback drawer reduces fragility but increases cognitive distance.
We will gate the cost delta feature behind a feature flag until backend estimates reach +-15% accuracy.
Metrics to measure: tutorial shown rate, completion rate, action-after-show (changed config), change in per-route cost over 14 days.
